node.statement: For a in {0,1}, applying Co_{R_a,T} to Co_{R,T}X_i and using the previous approximation, compression replacement, and R_a R_i=delta_{ai}R_i+O(e), gives Co_{R_a,T}Co_{R,T}X_i=delta_{ai}X_i+O(e)||X_i||. Summing i=0,1 and using the max norm yields ||BA-I||<=C e.
